title: Why Hand Block Printing Is Slow Fashion
excerpt: Why hand block printed clothing is a sustainable, slow-fashion choice – natural fabrics, artisan skills and clothes made to last.
body:
Slow fashion means buying fewer, better clothes that are made thoughtfully and last longer. Hand block printing fits that idea naturally.

## Made by hand, not by machine

Each motif is stamped by an artisan using a hand-carved wooden block. A single outfit can take hours of careful work.

## Natural fabrics

Block printing is usually done on cotton and other natural fabrics that are breathable and comfortable.

## Supporting artisan communities

Buying hand block prints supports karigars and keeps a centuries-old craft alive in places like Sanganer and Bagru, near Jaipur.

## Made to order means less waste

When clothes are made to order and to your measurements, fewer unsold pieces are produced and you are less likely to return or throw away something that doesn't fit.

## Built to last

A well-made cotton kurta set can be worn for years. With gentle washing, block prints soften and become more comfortable over time.

## Caring for your block prints

- Wash separately in cold water the first few times.
- Use a mild detergent.
- Dry in shade to protect the colours.

## Made to measure, shipped worldwide

Every Bahe Kurtiz piece is made in our own Jaipur studio and can be stitched to your measurements at no extra cost. Pieces are made in 5–7 working days and shipped by express courier with tracking, usually arriving in 5–10 business days in the USA, UK, Canada, UAE and Australia.
